title: Round lines or round the total
hook: Rounding three tiny lines separately can differ from rounding their sum once.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Compare line-level rounding with aggregate rounding under a stated convention.

misconception: Rounding before summing is always identical to rounding after summing.
objective: Compare line-level rounding with aggregate rounding under a stated convention.

claims.text: Each fictional line is exactly €0.335 before rounding. A rounds each line to cents; B sums first and rounds once. Scaled model; toy rule: nearest cent, half upward; no billing-law claim.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Lines=3, A=€1.02 and B=€1.01. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*","x",["round",0.335]]; B=["round",["*","x",0.335]]; x denotes Lines. At x=3, A=1.02, B=1.01. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Rounding loses information at each application. Three rounded €0.34 lines sum to €1.02, while €1.005 rounded once gives €1.01 under the stated half-up rule. Actual billing conventions need their own rule.

The principle follows from those expressions and stated scenario limits. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Four fictional lines are each exactly €0.125, rounded half-up to cents. What do you get rounding each line first, and rounding the total once? Correct: €0.52 and €0.50. Each line rounds to €0.13, so four make €0.52; the exact total €0.50 needs no rounding. Rounding loses information each time.
